capabilities.description: Central registry of every vehicle with plate/VIN, branch assignment, category, status (available, rented, in maintenance, off-road), mileage, and service history. Supports per-vehicle lifecycle tracking and cross-branch visibility.

End-to-end rental lifecycle: reservations, rental agreements, pickup/return handling, extensions, deposits, damage/incident notes, and per-vehicle availability to prevent double-booking across branches.
Preventive maintenance schedules per vehicle by date or mileage, workshop/service job tracking, costs, downtime, and automated reminders before a vehicle goes off-road.
Rate cards by vehicle category, branch, season, and duration; extra charges for mileage, fuel, late return, and extras; deposits held and released. Includes price override tracking for audit.
Invoices, credit notes, deposit tracking and release, outstanding balances, and per-branch revenue reporting.
Per-branch dashboards plus a company-wide rollup showing fleet utilisation, revenue, and profitability across all locations.
Analytics dashboard for fleet utilisation, revenue per branch and per vehicle, maintenance cost, overdue returns, and unpaid invoices.
Immutable audit log of key actions such as contract changes, deposit releases, and price overrides, with evidence verification and file hashing for integrity.

summary: A back-office management platform for a car rental company with 4 branches and 20 staff (sales agents, accountants, branch managers). It provides role-based access to a central vehicle registry, end-to-end rental contracts with cross-branch availability, preventive maintenance scheduling, multi-branch pricing, invoicing with deposit tracking, analytics dashboards, audit trails, and email-only notifications.
